MA.office: Governor and lieutenant governor (Boston central tabulation ONLY)
MA.notes: BOSTON CENTRAL TABULATION ONLY: advanced-processed early/mail governor votes, NOT combined Election Day results, all-mode margins or statewide Massachusetts coverage. All 275 precinct counts and write-in/blank accounting reconcile to the native city footer. The separate combined citywide HTML is not allocated to these precincts. No registration denominator, turnout fraction or demographic participation is inferred. Worcester's complete report supplies only independently visually checked explicit ticket-party labels; its counts and ballot-counter anomaly are not used for Boston. The actual November 3, 2026 polling-page app selects these polygons and its popups explicitly name that date. Legacy Preliminary service title and Fall 2025 webmap metadata remain documented: this is an app-selected reference, not newly surveyed/certified 2026 boundaries. All complete original documents, native reference and acquisition failures are downloadable.
MA.next_action: Acquire combined all-mode Boston precinct returns and other Massachusetts municipalities; independently reconcile Worcester OCR/modes and ballot counters; seek unique-person participation and actual group denominators.
